translation:
[Event Notice] Venture Park Vol. 10, Beyond AI: The Moment Technology Changes Reality – Lectures and Networking for Startups (Thursday, 26 November)

Where will the next change in AI begin?

In 2026, artificial intelligence advanced rapidly and brought new changes across industry and business. As generative AI and AI agents change the way we work and our business models, AI is now moving beyond digital space and expanding into the real world by combining with robots.

Where will AI technology head next? And what new opportunities will these changes bring to our lives, to industry and to the future of startups?

Two perspectives will be presented: that of the CEO of Hurotics, who is also a professor at Chung-Ang University, who researches wearable robot technology that understands and assists human movement and who has developed research results into real products and business by founding Hurotics; and that of a professor at Kyung Hee University who researches the industrial application of AI technology and AI-based business models and has analysed the changes AI will bring to the economy and industry. Through these two perspectives, the event will look back on the major changes in the AI industry in 2026, look ahead to technology and industry in 2027, and explore the future that physical AI will bring to human life and industrial sites.

Beyond technological progress, toward real-world change: come and experience the moment new industry and business opportunities are created.

Venture Park, SVC Seoul's startup networking event, invites you to its final session of 2026, "BEYOND AI: The Moment Technology Changes Reality".

[Event Overview]

- Date and time: Thursday, 26 November 2026, 17:00–20:00
- Venue: Open Stage, B1, SVC Seoul (136 Yanghwa-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul)
- Audience: Founders, staff and investors of startups in the AI field, and people involved in the startup ecosystem
- Participation fee: Free; a light meal will be provided
- Application: luma.com/venturepark

See you at Venture Park!
